comment: Two fonts the sample's own project does not name. DiagPipelineRunner.cs builds them beside the sample's own output, into xna4-build/bin-diag/Content, from xna4-diag/Content -- they differ from hudFont.spritefont only in <Spacing>, so the first-glyph advance rule can be measured with a non-zero spacing as well as with zero. FontDescriptionImporter/FontDescriptionProcessor, the file's stem as the name, Windows/Reach, CompressContent false, BuildConfiguration Debug. Recorded 2026-09-10 (plans/plan_xna_sample_xnb_sweep.md XNASWEEP-163).
